cohort: 4,240,284 women with HDP delivery hospitalizations between 2004 and 2014 in the United States National Inpatient Sample
finding: While the incidence of stroke in women with HDP has declined, it is associated with longer hospital stays, higher costs, and increased risk of maternal mortality and delivery complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of stroke in women with HDP.
